decisions.statement: A sweep of no terminals is answered without any wait.
Every terminal in one sweep is asked at once rather than in turn.
One expiry timer bounds a whole sweep rather than one timer for each terminal.
A terminal answering nothing before the bound is read as never answered.
A terminal whose answer fails is read as never answered rather than thrown.
A terminal answering an undefined id is read as having no process.
A reading names the terminal that reading was taken from.
A tally counts the terminals swept as well as the terminals read.
A tally line names a count of zero only for the terminals read.
A terminal is described by the options that terminal was created with rather than by an id.
A terminal answering no id is left out of the pairs handed back.
Nothing here names the editor's own terminal type.

definition: the process id a terminal answers with and the outcome of asking each terminal
